A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] worked as a [[Flight Control|'''flight controller''']]''' '''at the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[Troy Denning]] created this individual for his novel ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'', published by [[Del Rey]] in [[2005]]. It is unclear from the context of the novel whether the Bith is a Jedi or part of a civilian staff on Ossus.
